LanguageData.VCE_Canola.description: A bright-yellow flowering variety of the rapeseed, cultivated mainly for its oil-rich seed.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Canola, though not directly edible, can be very efficiently converted into chemfuel at a refinery.
LanguageData.VCE_Canola.label: canola plant
LanguageData.VCE_FragrantbloomRose.description: A unique rose variety cultivated for its intense, captivating scent, perfect for making perfumes and other aromatic products.
LanguageData.VCE_FragrantbloomRose.label: fragrantbloom rose
LanguageData.VCE_Hyacinth.description: A vibrant, sweet-smelling flower with a fresh, green fragrance that adds depth to gardens and perfumes alike.
LanguageData.VCE_Hyacinth.label: hyacinth
LanguageData.VCE_Jasmine.description: A vibrant, sweet-smelling flower with a fresh, green fragrance that adds depth to gardens and perfumes alike.
LanguageData.VCE_Jasmine.label: jasmine
LanguageData.VCE_Lavender.description: A fragrant, purple-flowered plant known for its calming scent and ornamental beauty.
LanguageData.VCE_Lavender.label: lavender
LanguageData.VCE_Lily.description: A striking flower with a rich, sweet, and sometimes spicy fragrance that fills any space with elegance.
LanguageData.VCE_Lily.label: lily
LanguageData.VCE_Orchid.description: A delicate and exotic bloom with a subtle, sweet scent that varies by species, often used in sophisticated perfumes.
LanguageData.VCE_Orchid.label: orchid
LanguageData.VCE_Plumeria.description: A tropical flower with a fruity, sweet, and creamy fragrance, perfect for creating a lush, warm atmosphere.
LanguageData.VCE_Plumeria.label: plumeria
LanguageData.VCE_Tulip.description: A beautiful but mild-scented flower known more for its vibrant colors than its fragrance.
LanguageData.VCE_Tulip.label: tulip
LanguageData.VCE_Vanilla.description: Delicate, creamy-white flowers with a light, sweet fragrance. While the flowers are beautiful, it’s the pods they produce that are prized for their warm, rich scent. We put some vanilla in your Vanilla Expanded so you can expand vanilla while you vanilla your expansion.
LanguageData.VCE_Vanilla.label: vanilla
LanguageData.VCE_Violet.description: A soft, powdery, and sweet-smelling flower, often used to add a gentle floral note to perfumes.
LanguageData.VCE_Violet.label: violet
LanguageData.VCE_YlangYlang.description: A highly fragrant, sweet, and rich flower, prized for its use in exotic and sensual perfumes.
